guard_pose: wide crouched stance facing right, the sword held forward and angled up in the front hand, a round dark shield raised on the back arm

jab: quick straight thrust: drives the sword in his front hand straight forward at full extension, then pulls it back into the stance
jab2: backhand slash: swings the sword in his front hand from high in front down to low in front in one fast diagonal cut, then back into the stance
ftilt: big forward cut: lifts the sword in his front hand above his head and brings it straight down to low in front of him, then back into the stance
utilt: overhead arc: sweeps the sword in his front hand from in front of him up over his head to behind him, then back into the stance
dtilt: crouching low cut: drops into a crouch and sweeps the sword in his front hand low in front at shin height, then rises back into the stance
dashattack: jumping slash: runs forward, leaps and swings the sword across in a wide horizontal cut, the round shield held at his side, then lands and settles back into the stance
fsmash: charged smash: raises the sword in his front hand far behind his head, golden light gleaming along the blade, then brings it down in a tremendous cut to the front, then recovers into the stance
usmash: rising smash: crouches, then swings the sword in his front hand in a big arc from in front straight up over his head, golden light gleaming along the blade, then back into the stance
dsmash: low spinning cut: slashes the sword in his front hand low in front, then spins around and slashes low behind him, golden light gleaming along the blade, then back into the stance
nair: spinning double cut in mid-air: chops the sword down in front of him, then swings it back up, the blade making a full circle around his body, the round shield kept on his other arm, then back to the tucked pose
fair: crescent cut in mid-air: swings the sword in a big arc from above his head down to below him in front, then back to the tucked pose
bair: backward cut in mid-air: twists his torso and swings the sword behind him in a downward arc, then back to the tucked pose
uair: overhead arc in mid-air: swings the sword from behind him over his head to the front, then back to the tucked pose
dair: downward stab in mid-air: points the sword straight down beneath him and plunges it down, then pulls it back up to the tucked pose
ledgeattack: rises from a low crouch with a quick low horizontal cut of the sword forward at knee height, then back into the stance
getupattack: from lying on his back, swings the sword low across in front of him, then behind him while springing to his feet, ending in the stance

nspecial: bow shot: swaps the sword for a wooden bow, nocks an arrow and pulls the string back to his cheek, then looses the arrow forward and slightly upward, then lowers the bow and returns to the stance with sword and shield
sspecial: bomb throw: pulls out a small round bomb with the free hand and lobs it forward and upward in an overhand arc, then returns to the stance with sword and shield
uspecial: Ascend: raises one hand above his head, a shimmer of green Zonai light wraps around his body, then he shoots straight up with the body stretched upward, green sparkles trailing below him, ending high in mid-air with the arm raised
dspecial: Ultrahand: lowers the shield and stretches the arm with the glowing green Zonai markings straight forward, palm open, a beam of green light reaches out ahead of the hand and closes as if gripping something, then he pulls the hand back and returns to the stance
ultimate: Light Dragon: raises the sword high above his head with both hands, golden light pours down around him and gathers along the blade, he holds it as the glow grows brighter and brighter, then swings it down to the front releasing a wide burst of golden light straight forward, holds the swing while the light streams ahead, then the glow fades and he returns to the stance
w0_nspecial: Master Sword beam: the blade glows white-blue, he raises the sword overhead, then swings it down to the front and a crescent beam of white-blue light shoots off the blade straight forward, then returns to the stance
w0_ultimate: Master Sword flurry: the blade glows white-blue, he dashes forward and slashes four times in quick succession, then raises the glowing sword overhead with both hands and swings it down to the front, a big crescent beam of white-blue light flies off the blade straight forward, then he returns to the stance
w1_nspecial: light arrow: a glowing golden bow of light appears in his hand, he draws a shining arrow of light back to his cheek, then looses it straight forward in a streak of golden light, then the bow fades and he returns to the stance with sword and shield
w1_ultimate: rain of light: a glowing golden bow of light appears in his hand, he aims straight up and looses four shining arrows of light into the sky one after another, then draws one last arrow glowing brighter and fires it straight up in a big flash of golden light, then the bow fades and he returns to the stance with sword and shield

walk: walks forward to the right in side profile, the sword still held forward in the front hand and the round shield on the back arm: the back leg steps past the front leg, then the other, the body and head stay turned to the right the whole time exactly like the first frame, a seamless two-step walk cycle that ends exactly on the first pose
crouch: squats down very low on the spot: knees fully bent, hips dropped almost to the heels, back bent forward, the sword still held forward in the front hand and the round shield on the back arm
shield: braces to block: raises the round shield in front of his body, the sword held back and crouches slightly, a defensive guard

notes: makeLink: buildSwordNormals(S=1.0, P=0.92, smashFx=Light) -> no jab3 (skip). baseWeapon ShieldAndSword (sword + round shield); the guard picture's blue-hilted sword already looks like the Master Sword, so the base clips just say 'the sword' and the w0 clips make it glow. Timings: nspecial bow: arrow at f20/40 (arcs down, pose Bow); sspecial bomb: lobbed up-forward at f14/38 (vel 6.5,-6.5, explodes, pose Throw); uspecial Ascension: rises at f4 (vy -18), intangible f4-18, body hit f4-8, helpless -> pin None, ends in the air; dspecial Emprise (Ultrahand): long-range GRAB f10-18 at 96 px (pose Cast) -> on a catch the generic hold/throws play. Weapons: w0 'Epee de legende' (MasterSword) replaces nspecial (piercing sword beam at f14/40, pose Overhead) + jab + ultimate (EPEE DE LEGENDE: teleports to the foe f34, 4 hits from f43, sword beam at f66/100). w1 'Arc de lumiere' (BowOfLight) replaces nspecial (piercing light arrow f16/38) + jab (quick arrow) + ultimate (PLUIE DE LUMIERE: light pillars on every foe at f36/45/54/63, big one f86/108 -> the clip shoots upward, the pillars are drawn by the game). Base ultimate DRAGON DE LUMIERE: beam f40-68/100 (1100 px, pose Overhead), the dragon drawn by the game (UltFx::LightDragon). Source: TotK Link is right-handed and his right arm is Rauru's glowing Zonai arm, but the guard picture puts the green glow on the shield arm -> dspecial says 'the arm with the glowing green Zonai markings'. Inconsistencies: the Bow of Light is a Breath of the Wild item (final battle), not TotK; in TotK the Light Dragon (Zelda) fires no beam; 'Bombe Zonai' = the Zonai Time Bomb / bomb flower, written as 'a small round bomb'. state_fixes: suggested walk/crouch/shield texts for the sword-and-shield guard; not applied by clips.py.
